biography:
With a robust background in preconstruction and project engineering, the focus at Holder Construction has been on optimizing project cost-efficiency and schedule effectiveness. The role involves preparing detailed project estimates, engaging with subcontractors, and leading bid proposal evaluations to ensure that each construction phase meets owner specifications and standards. 

Our team's expertise in project planning and construction project management is evident through the successful mediation of complex issues and fostering collaborative environments. This dedication to excellence is further reinforced by Procore certifications, which have been instrumental in managing construction documents and facilitating constructive dialogue between all project stakeholders.
